title: Roll a die
description:
Write `int rollDie(std::mt19937& rng)` that returns a random whole number from 1 to 6, each equally likely.

The random engine is handed in (the `&` means the function uses the caller's engine rather than a copy, which you will learn about in milestone 4). Your job is the distribution:

```cpp
std::uniform_int_distribution<int> die{ 1, 6 };
return die(rng);
```

The tests roll it thousands of times and check that every result is between 1 and 6 and that all six numbers turn up.
